reviews.text: Highly satisfied with Kontota and especially Sean! He took his time, kept me updated, and did an amazing job on my 9 year old German Shepherd. Will definitely be a repeat customer.

I would like to give the absolute highest gratitude to Destiny for her service, time, and care with our fur-baby TipToe. For the first time in a very long time he has been going through our home with a renewed and refreshed spirit. He has all the pep in his step because of the Kontota grooming experience. Thank you!! 10/10 recommend!!
We will be a returning customer! 🥰🐶🐕🐾🤗

First off, having a mobile dog grooming van come to us makes life so easy.  We were very glad to hear Winston did well at his last appointment.  We know he gets very nervous when getting groomed. We had tried another company but Winston ended up getting a cut so we returned back to Kontota.
Great job on both of our dogs. Loved the before and after pictures! The stylist was friendly and made our doggies look super handsome!

Sean was so wonderful with my pups. I felt very comfortable leaving them with him. I will definitely be back for another grooming!

We have been using Kontota for about 7 months now. Our groomer has always been Naily and we love her!! So does Journey, our almost 3 year old purebred collie. Journey was rescued about 7 1/2 months ago. She was in the rescue for quite a while and is a very timid, jumpy girl!! Naily is perfect for her!! She’s patient and very gentle with Journey and Journey has grown quite confident when it comes to grooming because of Naily!! I would highly recommend Naily to anyone!!

I had an extremely disappointing experience with Kontota Grooming and would not recommend them.

During my appointment, the groomer stated she did not want to brush out my goldendoodle’s tangles and instead chose to shave him completely down, without my permission. This was never discussed or approved beforehand. On top of that, the grooming itself was poorly done—his ears were uneven and his tail was noticeably uneven as well. Overall, the quality of work was unacceptable.

I addressed this directly with management at the time and made it clear that I was unhappy with the service and would not be paying due to how my dog was handled and the lack of consent.

Now, months later, I am being contacted again and pressured to pay a disputed invoice that management was already aware of. Continuing to reach out long after the issue was discussed feels unprofessional and harassing.

Pet owners trust groomers with members of their family. This experience showed a serious lack of communication, consent, and accountability. I strongly encourage others to be cautious and ensure expectations are clearly documented before booking.
